changelog:
**Revamped to provide free, live web search via the Z.AI GLM-4.5-Flash model and built-in web_search tool.**

- No longer requires paid Web Search API balance; uses free Coding Plan keys.
- Reworked search script for direct integration with GLM-4.5-Flash's live web search.
- Removed non-GLM-based content extraction (scripts/extract.mjs deprecated).
- Updated documentation to reflect new usage, options, and model capabilities.
- Real-time results with real URLs, automatic multilingual support, and improved domain filtering.
- No hallucinated URLs—returns only genuine, live web results.
summary: Free live web search powered by Z.AI GLM-4.5-Flash with built-in web_search tool. Real-time results, real URLs, zero cost. Works with Z.AI Coding Plan keys — no separate API balance required.
